summary: All 40 source hashes and sizes matched, and all eight proposed computations reproduced. The fasting contrast passes both effect-concordance criteria. Ten paired effects round to zero in the browser bundle, changing sign agreement from 16,575/16,906 to 16,570/16,896. All 789 shared FDR discoveries survive rounding. The corrected proposal also records a discrepancy in the author’s normalized mean counts. It passed the repository proposal checker.
openIssues: The numerical reference is the bioRxiv workbook. Equivalence to the journal worksheet remains unverified.
Four Excel date cells have ambiguous gene identifiers, leaving three registered genes unpaired.
Individual animal identities, pooling and the exact DESeq2 settings remain undocumented. Default normalization did not reproduce all author base means.
